name: Echo Ngozi-Kobayashi
description:
Catmod full set — retractable ears, retractable claws, modified inner ear with directional hearing tuned to the network's lower frequencies. Echo does not hack the way the street talks about hacking. She listens. The augmentation chain in her skull translates ambient network traffic into something her brain processes as sound, and she has spent six years learning what the sound means. A corponation badge bleating its idle keepalive sounds different from a corponation badge that has just been pickpocketed. A BCI running a sleep-suppression protocol sounds different from a BCI running an alibi simulation. Echo can tell you, walking down a street, which apartments are awake and which are pretending.

She operates solo when she can. She brings muscle in when the contract goes physical, which is roughly thirty percent of her work. Kyle is on her short list because Kyle does not flinch and does not ask follow-up questions and does not bill her for time spent waiting in vans.
heritage: Igbo-Japanese — mother's family from Lagos via the Pulse network corridor, father's family from Osaka via the second-generation refugee waves. Echo speaks neither parent's first language fluently and has stopped feeling bad about it.
specialty: network listening, information extraction, electronic surveillance and counter-surveillance, BCI signal analysis
method: audio-domain processing of network and BCI signals; her augmented hearing is the tool, the implant suite is the processor
code: information should be free, but secrets that are kept for good reasons stay kept; she does not extract for blackmail or sale to third parties; she takes contracts to recover specific information for the person it belonged to
signature_gear: the augmented ears themselves (Tier 4 catmod surgery, Lagos-based clinic, the kind that does not advertise); a pair of fingerless gloves with retractable carbon-fiber claws (Tier 3 standard catmod accessory); a single concealed-carry compact pistol she has fired once in six years; a notebook in a script she invented at fifteen and has not shared with anyone
relationship_to_kyle: professional and warm. They have worked together on four contracts over three years. Echo trusts Kyle because Kyle does not need things explained twice and does not stay in scenes longer than the contract requires. She brings him into jobs where the network signal points at something the network does not want noticed. He calls her Echo. She calls him Kyle. Neither of them has met the other's neighbors and neither of them has asked to.
aesthetic: androgynous, lean, dark clothing that does not advertise. The ears are usually retracted in public; when they're extended she is working. Walks everywhere. Hates motorcycles on principle.
spin_off_hook: A contract to recover stolen wedding rings turns into something that puts Echo across the table from a corponation R&D director whose unpublished surveillance protocols she has been listening to for two years without his knowledge. She has to decide what to do with the listening when the listening becomes leverage.
